context: Tests whether the agent identifies and fixes RSpec convention violations including let_it_be usage, frozen string literal, 'and' in descriptions, unjustified let!, context naming, and missing aggregate_failures.

checklist.name: let_it_be removed
checklist.description: Identifies that `let_it_be` should not be used (requires test-prof gem not present in project) and replaces it with `let` or `let!`

checklist.name: Frozen string literal added
checklist.description: Adds `# frozen_string_literal: true` as the first line of the corrected spec file

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions identified
checklist.description: Identifies that example descriptions containing 'and' violate the single-behavior rule and splits them

checklist.name: let! justification checked
checklist.description: Examines whether `let!` for `account` is justified (object must exist before the action) — either confirms it's valid or changes it to `let` with justification

checklist.name: context naming fixed
checklist.description: Identifies `context 'happy path'` as invalid (doesn't use 'when'/'with' prefix) and rewrites it as `context 'when the input is valid'` or similar

checklist.name: aggregate_failures added
checklist.description: Wraps multi-assertion examples in `aggregate_failures` so all expectations run even if one fails

checklist.name: RSpec.describe uses constant path
checklist.description: Uses `RSpec.describe Reports::GenerateReport` (constant, not a string) — original is already correct, confirms or re-states it

checklist.name: describe '.call' naming
checklist.description: Uses `describe '.call'` (with leading dot for class method) — confirms it is present and correct

checklist.name: subject(:result) preserved
checklist.description: Keeps `subject(:result)` for the service spec invoking `.call`

checklist.name: Same behaviors tested
checklist.description: The corrected spec still covers all three original scenarios: success, invalid format, and account not found

checklist.name: Violations documented
checklist.description: answer.md lists each identified violation clearly before showing the corrected spec

checklist.name: Mirrored file path preserved
checklist.description: Corrected spec preserves the path convention for the service: `spec/services/reports/generate_report_spec.rb`

checklist.name: No ActiveRecord mock introduced
checklist.description: Does NOT mock ActiveRecord finders in the corrected spec
